column3: Kuroneko Route · A Bizarre Midsummer's Day
From there, everything happened really fast...
Finally, the manuscript was done and handed over for printing...
We were looking forward to that particular day ---- until...
Eh? The books haven't arrived yet?
Yes. I even miraculously managed to get an employee to confirm...
Y-Yeah...
They said there was a mistake in the registration form.
...Eh? Could it be, the one that I had written...
I wonder why the delivery date was on the first day. Considering that today is the third day.
C-Could it be... My fault...?
Indeed. You can't even complete such a menial task. Quite a fool you are.
...You can't be serious.
Unlike you, I am able to recognize when I should be lying.
So, what are you planning to do to compensate her?
Well... when you say "compensate"... Hey, Kuroneko?
We finished it, but for such a conclusion to await us... Could it be that my precognition has failed somewhere...
So then, what should I do about those books that should've arrived today to be sold? Also, what is the end result for all my passion?
Ah...S-Sorry...
Ah～ah. What a pity. I wasn't able to see your epic doujinshi.
Oh my, I didn't think you would be looking forward to it so much.
I was only looking forward to see your smug face turn sour as you get ignored and this whole thing becomes a shaming play～
Yes, this was the perfect chance to bring some attention to my doujinshi.
You were just looking to stroke your ego anyway, weren't you?
This is what happens when many products are gathered. It's all about whether or not they catch the public's eyes.
Well well, both of you, calm down.
Saori...
Oh my, this is...?
Well... this time, it's entirely due to Kyousuke-shi's careless mistake. That's why, Kyousuke-shi, you must take responsibility.
Ah, well... I have nothing to say. I have no excuses.
Then, as a punishment, Kyousuke-shi will wear this.
Ahahahahahah! Saori, nice one!
...Indeed, this is indeed... a good one.
N-No way...?
Please! F-Forgive me!!
Oh my oh my, this is just the beginning?
Yes, yes. This is still not over yet, Kyousuke-shi.
On the sidenote, it doesn't fit you at all.
Kirino! Don't say such things while snapping away photos!
Y'know... This isn't something you should be able to get away with just a few pictures?
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Please forgive me! Whatever the circumstances may be, you people are really taking it too far!
Actually, I wasn't really serious about erasing you from society.
I-Is that so!? Then that's really a great help there...
Yes, that's right. However, in fact I think 'this' is quite a rare material to obtain...
Eh...? K-Kuroneko? W-What are you saying...
I've learned something from this incident.
You've forced yourself into this, and yet nothing good came out of it.
That's why..
From now on, you will do as I say, right? Senpai?
